method: Execute the unchanged original qword-store instruction with explicit finite80-bit FP0 input and stop before the next instruction. Input values are generated with the existing independently checked wide model; this isolates double-store rounding, not original evaluation of the generating arithmetic.
limits: Exact zero has the shared representation positive sign. Nonzero underflow preserves sign; overflow follows native masked-exception infinity storage.
This is instruction-level support evidence, not a newly recovered native function. Managed replay is prepared separately and not executed.
